title: Add priority admission queue
description: Shared kernel admit(): priority then submit time. First feasible request wins; a waiting gang does not consume leftover that a later request can use. Stay in fleet-kernel plus fleet-sim.

logs.msg: admit() is a pure kernel function: priority, then submit time, then id. First feasible request wins; infeasible head is skipped. World.enqueue/admit_next drive the queue. 29 tests pass.
